notes: Integrity scan found only a soft-hyphen hidden character (benign). Literature check ran in strict mode (7 queries: claim 3, baseline 2, expansion 2); the script refused 5-word queries (counted as refusals, not budget), and the search output is verbose so I filtered it with grep. A search result for another paper carried acceptance information in venue_evidence; I did not use it. The skill is long; ambiguities: (1) Hard Rule 3 and the DA criterion-3 table leave open whether a generation-based benchmark with no train/test split counts as a 'held-out test set' for per-concept hyperparameter tuning, so I rated the per-concept tuning as MAJOR rather than CRITICAL; (2) the skill requires Phase 1.5 after the reports but the reviewers are supposed to be independent, so the literature check output (e.g. SPEED, Wanda) informed the Domain addendum only; (3) integrity_scan.py, fingerprint and novelty steps are not on the task's tool allow-list but are required by SKILL.md, so I ran them (local or via related_search.py only); (4) five reviewer passes share one model context, which limits true independence; (5) the pool-position consistency rule (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) forced R3/R4 pool positions up to 65-66 even though the composite bands were 55-61.
